description.default: Stores an API key in the host's encrypted secret store and calls a Bearer-protected endpoint from an AI tool. Demonstrates host.secrets.* and host.http.request.
description.zh-CN: 把 API Key 存进宿主加密存储，再由 AI 工具带它对需要 Bearer 认证的接口发起请求。演示 host.secrets.* 与 host.http.request。

description.default: Call the configured endpoint with the stored API key and report whether it is accepted. Use it to check the key saved in the plugin settings.
description.zh-CN: 用已保存的 API Key 请求配置的接口，返回该 Key 是否被接受；用于验证插件设置里保存的凭据。
